dialogues.speaker: Dutta
dialogues.text: Kind soul, emissary of the gods, thank you for your help! Without you, I would have had to find a Tatankasaurus to help solve my quandary.

dialogues.speaker: Dutta
dialogues.text: Ah, whenever I came across rocks or monsters in the fallow fields before, I always had to rely on Tatankasaurs for help. This time, fortune has blessed me with you.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: It's mostly just the rocks. Once those have been cleared out, everything else is child's play. I've been farming for decades, so I'm pretty good at it by now.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Don't be put off by the state it's in at the moment. A little hard work will turn this into the most pristine field you've ever seen.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: How about I let you in on a little farmer's secret? This isn't something I usually tell people.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Every time I'm finished... answering nature's call, I collect all the "fertilizer" and spread it on my fields...

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Hey, there's no need to go pulling faces. This is all part of the great circle of life!

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Of course! You won't find a single farm in the Collective of Plenty that doesn't raise Tatankasaurs.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Chasing away forest boars and birds that come to steal crops, tilling the soil, and sowing seeds, Tatankasaurs can do it all!

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: And baby Tatankasaurs are very friendly and easy to raise. Just stick them in a field and they'll grow all by themselves...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They really grow just like that?

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: What I mean is, if you bring them with you when you're working, and leave them in the fields to play...

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: In a few years and a few harvests, you'll suddenly realize they've grown into adults.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Just like my son, Paqarin. That's exactly how he was raised.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: He's been watching me work since he was tiny. Now he's a grown and capable man.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: Time truly is merciless... No, no, I can't start thinking like that.

response.speaker: Dutta
response.text: I'm getting on a bit, but my legs work fine and I've still got all my teeth. I can still work for a good while yet!
